svg.desc: индикатор режима РАБОТА-РЕЗЕРВ-РЕМОНТ для Dull Screen

rt:param.name: TYPE
rt:param.comment: Тип привязки 1..3 - из конфигурации, 0 - локальные параметры

rt:param.name: DELIMITER
rt:param.comment: Разделитель между KKS и именем сигнала

rt:param.name: SIG_WORK
rt:param.comment: Имя сигнала или часть сигнала после разделителя для состояния "рабочий"

rt:param.name: SIG_RESERVE
rt:param.comment: Имя сигнала или часть сигнала после разделителя для состояния "резервный"

rt:param.name: SIG_REPAIR
rt:param.comment: Имя сигнала или часть сигнала после разделителя для состояния "в ремонте"

rect.rt:event:
Dim s as String
If (Pv_Work == Nothing) Then s = KKS + DELIMITER + SIG_WORK ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS+DELIMITER+SIG_WORK = \"" + s + "\"", 0)
ElseIf (Pv_Reserve == Nothing) Then s = KKS + DELIMITER+ SIG_RESERVE ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS+DELIMITER+SIG_RESERVE = \"" + s + "\"", 0)
ElseIf (Pv_Repair == Nothing) Then s = KKS + DELIMITER+ SIG_REPAIR ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки.\nKKS+DELIMITER+Sig_REPAIR = \"" + s + "\"", 0)
ElseIf (TYPE >= 1) && (TYPE <= 3) Then ' TYPE 1..3 s = KKS + "|" + "STAT" + CStr(TYPE) Open_TYPE_ws_wf_wi("PRJSPEC_RSD", s, Operate, "STAT" + CStr(TYPE))
Else ' TYPE 0 s = KKS + "|" + CStr(DELIMITER) + "|" + CStr(SIG_WORK) + "|" + CStr(SIG_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(SIG_REPAIR) + "|" + CStr(MASK_WORK) + "|" + CStr(MASK_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(MASK_REPAIR) + "|" + CStr(SIG_COMMAND) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_WORK) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_REPAIR) Open_ws_wf_wi("RSD", s, Operate)
End If
If Er_Link Then ShowMessage ("Ошибка привязки", 5) ElseIf Pv_Work != nothing Then Open_Win_Uni(False, "rights", "Права управления", "wi_rights", KKS + "|" + CStr(Operate)) Else NoLink(KKS) End If

If !Er_Link Then
Dim s as String Dim so as string dim si as string
If TYPE == 0 Then s = KKS + "|" + CStr(TYPE) + "|" + CStr(DELIMITER) + "|" + CStr(SIG_WORK) + "|" + CStr(SIG_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(SIG_REPAIR) + "|" + CStr(MASK_WORK) + "|" + CStr(MASK_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(MASK_REPAIR) + "|" + CStr(SIG_COMMAND) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_WORK) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_RESERVE) + "|" + CStr(CMD_SEL_REPAIR) so = "|RSDo|RSD " si = "|RSDi|RSD "
Else s = KKS + "|" + "STAT" + CStr(TYPE) so = "|RSDo|PRJSPEC_RSD " si = "|RSDi|PRJSPEC_RSD "
End If
if (Pv_Work != Nothing) && (Pv_Work == Pv_Reserve) && (Pv_Work == Pv_Repair) Then If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(Pv_OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + so + s) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + si + s) End If
Else Dim Pv as PlsPVBin Dim i as UByte i = 0 If Pv_Work != Nothing Then
TmpBuffer(i) = Pv_Work.PVId i = i + 1 Pv = Pv_Work End If
If Pv_Reserve != Nothing Then TmpBuffer(i) = Pv_Reserve.PVId If i = 0 Then Pv = Pv_Reserve End If i = i + 1 End If
If Pv_Repair != Nothing Then TmpBuffer(i) = Pv_Repair.PVId If i = 0 Then Pv = Pv_Repair End If End If
If Operate && Check_Oper_Rights(Pv_OU) Then LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + so + s) Else LoadPopUpMenu(KKS + si + s) End If End If
Else
ShowWarning ("Ошибка привязки", 0) End If
